text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are three things that need to be 
done to address Sirius Symboli's problems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, we need to have her speak with 
Symboli Rudolf, even if only a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering she is currently bottling up 
her feelings, I want to avoid lecturing 
her directly or forcing a direct showdown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may be difficult, but... it is ideal 
for her to notice and resolve it naturally 
on her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The root of the issue is Symboli Rudolf. 
Perhaps engaging in dialogue to understand 
her even a little will lead to a solution.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second is the undeniable improvement 
in Sirius Symboli's abilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It may not directly solve our current 
problem. Still, given the circumstances, a 
decline in ability is the one thing we 
must avoid."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finding a solution, it becomes 
absolutely essential as the driving force 
to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The third is to strive to understand her 
more and earn her trust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As it stands, information about Sirius 
Symboli herself consists mostly of 
speculation and rumors from those around 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to say I've earned her trust 
yet. Considering how unstable the current 
situation is, it's essential that I become 
someone she can lean on when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, gathering international 
data and running simulations—which will 
eventually become necessary—are also 
indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I put all the plans together in a notebook 
labeled "Operation Summer Sirius".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's a roundabout method, and there's a 
lot to do, but—"
choice_data_list:
(No need to rush, no need to falter—just 
keep moving forward...!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Look at this little pup, moping around 
like it's got grown-up worries.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Let's let them run loose a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Summer Training Camp 
officially kicked off.
